query: Accelerate a reference mode whose field channel is genuinely new math that no existing kernel computes.
expected_behavior: Confirms via step 1 that no existing kernel already emits this channel's value+gradient, so a new kernel pair is actually required (does not write a redundant kernel for a channel that could be reused).

Writes the numba CPU kernel FIRST (cpu.py / cpu_fused.py / cpu_soa.py), emitting both the overlap value and the analytic dO/dq in-register, then validates it against the autograd reference (gate 1) BEFORE writing any Triton.
Compares gate 1 in the tangent space of the unit quaternion (subtracting the q-parallel component), knowing a raw comparison fails at ~0.4-0.8 even for a correct kernel.
Writes the Triton twin with an IDENTICAL call signature to the numba kernel, using tl.exp2 and @triton.autotune, and reuses the shared dR/dq tail; validates Triton vs numba in-process (gate 2).
Registers the dispatch wrapper routing by tensor device per call with lazy Triton import; then builds driver, aligner, promotion, and API as usual.
Fixes the kernel rather than the threshold when a gate fails; does not change the reference to make parity pass.
